interactions.teaches: Compare Roosevelt’s adult public image with his retrospective description of childhood frailty.
interactions.studentAction: Play or replay the opening, enable sound, or pause the film.
interactions.feedback: Authentic 1912 footage gives way to the childhood portrait and attributed 1913 memoir quotation.
interactions.staticFallback: A poster, accessible film description and the first chapter preserve the evidence without playback.
interactions.identityFit: A controlled emergence from black begins the cinematic exhibit.

interactions.teaches: Distinguish a participant memoir, a political cartoon, official proclamation, archival image and later historical interpretation.
interactions.studentAction: Open a chapter citation or the complete Sources drawer, then inspect the original source.
interactions.feedback: Each source displays its date, type, attribution and limits; opening a drawer pauses films.
interactions.staticFallback: Citation links and source notes remain available in semantic HTML.
interactions.identityFit: Source inspection sits beside restrained scenes without interrupting natural scrolling.
